title: AquaPredict : Water Potability Prediction Using Machine Learning (MLOps)
summary: An MLOps pipeline that predicts water potability from tabular water-quality data using Random Forest, Logistic Regression, and XGBoost, with MLflow, DVC, and Streamlit for tracking and deployment. Its Streamlit app imports SDV's Metadata class and calls run_diagnostic and evaluate_quality from sdv.evaluation.single_table to assess data quality.
